Key Takeaways

  • Adangal (also called Pahani) is the record of rights for agricultural land — possession, cultivation and crop details.
  • The 1B extract shows the ownership details tied to the survey number.
  • Together they are essential for crop loans, land sales, and settling possession disputes.
  • They complement the Pattadhar Passbook and the Encumbrance Certificate in agricultural due diligence.
  • We retrieve current and historical extracts remotely.

The Adangal / Pahani and the 1B are the working records of agricultural land in Telangana. They record who is in possession, what crop is grown, and who the recorded owner is — the details banks and buyers check.

JaaGa retrieves your Adangal / Pahani and 1B extract, current or historical, so you can prove possession, apply for a loan, or verify land before buying.

When You Need These Records

Before buying agricultural land, to confirm possession and cultivation match the seller's claims.

For crop loans, government schemes, and to establish a possession history in a boundary or ownership dispute.

Common Problems We Solve

Possession vs ownership gap

The cultivator in the Adangal may differ from the recorded owner. We flag this crucial mismatch.

Old handwritten records

Historical pahani may be handwritten and hard to read. We retrieve and interpret them.

Survey number changes

Sub-divisions and re-surveys complicate lookups. We track the correct current number.

Why Adangal / Pahani (ROR 1B) Matters

Buying agricultural land where the person in possession isn't the recorded owner is a classic Telangana land trap. The Adangal / Pahani and 1B are how you catch that mismatch before you pay — and how you prove your own possession later.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between Adangal and 1B?

Adangal / Pahani records possession, cultivation and crop details; the 1B extract shows the recorded ownership. Both are read together for agricultural land.

Do I need these to buy agricultural land?

Yes — they confirm possession and cultivation, which should match the seller's claims and the passbook before you proceed.

Can you get historical Pahani?

Yes. Historical extracts help establish a long possession trail, useful in disputes and succession.

Is this the same as an EC?

No. An EC lists registered transactions; the Adangal/1B show possession and revenue ownership of agricultural land. Both matter.

Can NRIs order these remotely?

Yes, entirely over WhatsApp — we retrieve and deliver the extracts digitally.
